Decides whether `update --bootstrap` is rejected with an error or accepted.
Signals the unknown-argument failure to the caller.
Only computes a SetupArgs from its arguments; no observable effect.
Decides whether the run proceeds or is refused with EXIT_NEEDS_TERMINAL.
Returns the needs-terminal exit code to the caller when there is no terminal.
Decides whether `run` aborts with the refusal code before touching the install record.
The terminal check is acted on before the missing-release-dir check, so without a terminal that message wins.
Decides whether `run` aborts with the missing-release-dir code before looking up the home.

Stores the command later read when deciding whether to restart as `update --restarted`.
Only performs the write effect; nothing is computed for a caller.
Only performs the unended write/flush effect; nothing is computed for a caller.
Decides whether the session short-circuits into the resumed-run finish path.

Decides between the not-set-up message with EXIT_NOT_SET_UP and continuing the update.

Decides between the up-to-date exit 0 and offering the newer release.
